task.interrupted: This run was interrupted by a process restart (marked during startup recovery).

jobs.unexpectedRetry: The task encountered a temporary error and will retry shortly
jobs.unexpectedFailed: Task incomplete: an unknown error occurred. Check task details or ask Agent for help.
jobs.cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for a safe stopping point
jobs.resumed: Service restored; resuming from saved progress
jobs.cancelledSaved: Task cancelled; reusable progress has been saved
jobs.restarting: Service restarting; the task will resume automatically
jobs.handlerUnavailable: This version cannot run this task type. Update MovieClaw and try again.
jobs.definitionUnsupported: The task definition is incompatible with this version. Start it again from the original feature.
jobs.conflict: An identical task is already running
jobs.dismissFailedOnly: Only failed tasks can be dismissed. Cancel tasks that are still running.
jobs.retryFinishedOnly: Only failed, cancelled or blocked tasks can be retried

subscription.metadataNewEpisodes: Metadata refresh found {count, plural, one {# new episode} other {# new episodes}} starting at {first} and added them to tracking
subscription.siteEpisodeEvidence: A release for season {season}, episode {seen} appeared on a site ({title}), but TMDB lists only {known} episodes. If the series is longer, adjust its episode count in the subscription to keep tracking.
subscription.doubanEpisodeEvidence: Douban lists {count} episodes for season {season}, while TMDB lists {known}. Confirm the Douban count in the subscription to continue tracking.
subscription.dispatchRetry: Could not submit {units}: {reason}. Returned to the queue; retrying in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
subscription.releaseMissingUnits: Could not obtain {units} from "{title}": {reason}. Searching for other releases; this release will no longer be used for these episodes.
subscription.searchRetry: Could not search for "{title}": {reason}. Retrying in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
subscription.episodeHintDismissed: Dismissed the episode count hint for season {season}; continuing to use TMDB’s count
subscription.missingFilesRequeued: Library files are missing; requeued {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} for downloading
subscription.paused: Paused: release matching and searches will skip this subscription. Resume at any time.
subscription.ownerTransferred: The creator left; the earliest follower has taken over the subscription
subscription.newFollower: A member followed this subscription and will share the same downloads
subscription.smartVersionChanged: Several episodes did not match the claimed quality. The followed version was changed based on successful imports.
subscription.manualVersionKept: {units} was imported, but measured quality did not prove it better. Both versions were kept without automatic replacement. Delete unwanted versions in the library details.
subscription.replacementConfirmed: The alternative source has made real download progress. Switched {units} automatically to "{title}".
subscription.replacementRequested: An immediate source replacement was requested. Searching across sites for an alternative of equal or better quality.
subscription.replacementNotFound: The cross-site search returned {count, plural, one {# release} other {# releases}}, with no distinct alternative of the same quality. Keeping the old task; retrying in about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
subscription.replacementVerifying: Found an alternative of the same quality and started verifying {units}: "{title}" from {site}. The source will switch and the old source will be cleaned up only after real download progress.
subscription.replacementSearchUnavailable: The alternative source search is temporarily unavailable and will retry when site connections recover
subscription.identityCorrected: The files for {units} no longer belong to this title because their identity was corrected. Searching for releases again.
subscription.multipleUnits: {first} and others ({count, plural, one {# episode} other {# episodes}})
